tasks.title: Disable a device — omit its zone

hints: Open 10 Setting → 11 Omit Zones; 11 then ent is the full-menu shortcut.

Press esc to finish without setting. ent would start setting on a real panel.
tasks.completionMessage: Hall PIR is omitted in the simulation. Practise the companion restore task to include it again.

tasks.title: Re-enable a device — restore its zone
tasks.description: Reinstate the fictional Hall PIR on zone 1002, then finish using this keypad’s documented control.

tasks.completionMessage: Hall PIR is included again in the simulation. On site, verify the correct zone and its operation after reinstatement.

tasks.title: Read a zone resistance

Enter 1002, then press #.

tasks.title: Find an alarm in the log
tasks.description: Find the fictional intruder event and reveal its zone details.
hints: Open 22 Display Log. The newest event appears first.
Press B to move back to the INTRUDER event; A moves towards newer events.
Press # to reveal its extra details.

tasks.title: Walk-test a selected zone

hints: Open 31 Walk Test, then 2 Activate → 1 Silent → 2 Selected Zones.

tasks.title: Set a practice zone to Intruder

hints: Open 52 Program Zones through 50 Engineer 1. Enter 1003, then ent.
